options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Goal
options.doc: Which stage completion should be required to finish the slot.

options.name: Included Difficulties
options.doc: Which campaign difficulties are represented as Archipelago locations.

options.name: Tutorial Checks
options.doc: Include Tutorial 01 through Tutorial 10 as early checks.
options.doc_fr: Inclure le Tutoriel 01 au Tutoriel 10 comme vérifications précoces.

options.name: Wii Balance Board Levels
options.doc: Include Wii Balance Board Level 01 through Level 100 checks.
options.doc_fr: Inclure les vérifications de niveau 01 à niveau 100 de Wii Balance Board.

options.name: Random Starting World
options.doc: Start with one random accessible world per enabled difficulty.

options.name: Green Gem Sanity
options.doc: Add one Green Gem location to normal difficulty campaign levels that have a Green Gem.
options.doc_fr: Ajoutez un emplacement Green Gem à des niveaux de difficulté normale qui ont un Gem vert.

options.name: Kororin Capsule Sanity
options.doc: Add Kororin Capsule locations to all stages that have a Kororin Capsule.
options.doc_fr: Ajouter les emplacements de la gélule de Kororin à toutes les étapes qui ont une gélule de Kororin.

options.name: Required Stump Temple Pieces for Stump Temple Goal World Unlock
options.doc: Number of AP-side Stump Temple Pieces required to reach Stump Temple in your selected Goal Difficulty.
options.doc_fr: Nombre de pièces de temple côté AP nécessaires pour atteindre Temple Stump dans votre tâche sélectionnée Difficulté.

options.name: Hard Mode Unlock
options.doc: How Hard Mode is unlocked when Hard locations or the Hard goal are enabled.
options.doc_fr: Comment le Mode Dur est déverrouillé lorsque les emplacements Dur ou le but Dur sont activés.

options.name: Required Green Gems for Hard Mode
options.doc: Number of AP-side Green Gems required when Hard Mode Unlock is set to Green Gems.
options.doc_fr: Nombre de Gems Verts côté AP requis lorsque le mode dur Débloquer est mis à Green Gems.

options.name: Extra Counter Item Percentage
options.doc: Percent of extra AP-side Green Gem and Stump Temple Piece counter items added above the requirement.
options.doc_fr: Pourcentage d'éléments supplémentaires AP-side Green Gem et Stump Temple Piece compteur ajouté au-dessus de l'exigence.

options.name: Split Vehicle World Access
options.doc: Require both the vehicle item and matching world access item for W5/W6 logic.

options.name: Anthony Sanity
options.doc: Add Anthony locations from Hard difficulty stages 01 through 10.
options.doc_fr: Ajouter des emplacements Anthony des étapes 01 à 10.

options.name: Trophy Sanity
options.doc: Add trophy locations for the selected trophy tier.
options.doc_fr: Ajoutez des emplacements pour les trophées sélectionnés.

options.name: Trap Chance
options.doc: Percentage chance for filler to become one of the experimental traps.
options.doc_fr: Pourcentage de chances que le remplisseur devienne l'un des pièges expérimentaux.

options.name: Blackout Trap Weight
options.doc: Relative chance for Blackout Trap when a filler item becomes a trap.

options.name: Mirror Trap Weight
options.doc: Relative chance for Mirror Trap when a filler item becomes a trap.

options.name: Inverse Trap Weight
options.doc: Relative chance for Inverse Trap when a filler item becomes a trap.

options.name: Noclip Trap Weight
options.doc: Relative chance for Noclip Trap when a filler item becomes a trap.
